# Document history for the AWS CloudFormation User Guide

The following table describes important changes to the AWS CloudFormation User Guide content after May 2018. To receive notifications about documentation updates, you can subscribe to an RSS
feed.

###### Important

The table rows describing updates to the template reference content from May 2018 onward
have moved to the new _AWS CloudFormation Template Reference_. For these updates
and any future changes, see the [Document history for the AWS CloudFormation Template
Reference](../TemplateReference/doc-history.md "../TemplateReference/doc-history.md") in the _AWS CloudFormation Template Reference_.

| Change                                                                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Date              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| PDF guide available                                                                           | You can now download the \*AWS CloudFormation User Guide<br>• as a PDF.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | May 30, 2025      |
| Moved template reference content to a new guide                                               | CloudFormation published the _CloudFormation Template Reference Guide_. For<br>details, see [The CloudFormation Template Reference Guide](link-to-reference-guide.md "link-to-reference-guide.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | May 30, 2025      |
| IaC generator supports partial scanning                                                       | You can now choose specific resource types to scan for, making it easier to<br>generate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) templates from your existing resources. For<br>more information, see [Start a resource scan with<br>CloudFormation IaC generator](iac-generator-start-resource-scan.md "iac-generator-start-resource-scan.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | March 27, 2025    |
| Stack refactoring                                                                             | Stack refactoring simplifies reorganizing the resources in your CloudFormation stacks<br>while still preserving the existing resource properties and data. For more<br>information, see [Stack refactoring](stack-refactoring.md "stack-refactoring.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | February 6, 2025  |
| Troubleshoot stack deployments with Amazon Q Developer                                        | You can now use Amazon Q Developer to troubleshoot common errors when deploying CloudFormation<br>stacks. For more information, see [Troubleshoot unsuccessful<br>CloudFormation stack deployments with Amazon Q Developer](cfn-troubleshooting-with-amazon-q.md "cfn-troubleshooting-with-amazon-q.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | November 22, 2024 |
| Stack deployment timeline graph                                                               | You can now see a visual representation of your stack deployment. The stack<br>deployment timeline graph shows the stack deployment status, individual resource<br>deployment statuses, and the times the deployment statuses changed. For more<br>information, see [View a timeline of a<br>CloudFormation stack deployment](stack-deployment-timeline-graph.md "stack-deployment-timeline-graph.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | November 11, 2024 |
| Visualize your scanned resources and generated templates                                      | You can now streamline your Infrastructure as Code (IaC) generator workflows by<br>visualizing scan summary details and previewing the generated templates before<br>deploying your infrastructure stack. For more information, see [View the<br>scan summary in the CloudFormation console](generate-IaC-view-scan-summary.md "generate-IaC-view-scan-summary.md") and [Create a<br>CloudFormation stack from scanned resources](iac-generator-create-stack-from-scanned-resources.md "iac-generator-create-stack-from-scanned-resources.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | August 22, 2024   |
| Amazon EventBridge integration with AWS CloudFormation Git sync                               | AWS CloudFormation Git sync now publishes sync status changes as events to Amazon EventBridge. For more<br>information, see [Repository Sync<br>Status Change event detail](event-detail-respository-sync-status-change.md "event-detail-respository-sync-status-change.md") and [Resource Sync Status<br>Change event detail](event-detail-resource-sync-status-change.md "event-detail-resource-sync-status-change.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | July 29, 2024     |
| Force delete stuck stacks                                                                     | Two new options to force delete stacks is available for stack deletion operations<br>that are stuck. You can now choose to force delete the stack but retain the resource,<br>or the force delete the entire stack. For more information, see [Delete a stack<br>from the CloudFormation console](cfn-console-delete-stack.md "cfn-console-delete-stack.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | May 22, 2024      |
| AWS CloudTrail event stack operation root causes                                              | CloudFormation improves the troubleshooting experience for stack operations with a new<br>AWS CloudTrail deep-link integration. This feature directly links stack operation events in<br>the CloudFormation console to relevant CloudTrail events. For more information, see [Determine the cause of a stack failure](determine-root-cause-for-stack-failures.md "determine-root-cause-for-stack-failures.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | May 15, 2024      |
| Property level change sets                                                                    | Property level change sets allow you to preview the changes that CloudFormation<br>deployments will make to the property values of resources. For more information, see<br>[View a change set<br>for a CloudFormation stack](using-cfn-updating-stacks-changesets-view.md "using-cfn-updating-stacks-changesets-view.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | April 12, 2024    |
| CloudFormation introduces the CONFIGURATION_COMPLETE event                                    | You can now use the `CONFIGURATION_COMPLETE` event to enable faster<br>workflows involving the creation of resources. For more information, see [Understand CloudFormation stack creation events](stack-resource-configuration-complete.md "stack-resource-configuration-complete.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | March 11, 2024    |
| Generate AWS CloudFormation templates and AWS CDK applications from existing AWS<br>resources | You can now generate a template using resources provisioned in your account that<br>are not already managed by CloudFormation. For more information, see [Generate templates from<br>existing resources with IaC generator](generate-IaC.md "generate-IaC.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | February 2, 2024  |
| StackSets concurrency mode                                                                    | Concurrency Mode is a parameter for `StackSetOperationPreferences` that<br>allows you to choose how the concurrency level behaves during stack set operations.<br>For more information, see [Choose the Concurrency Mode for CloudFormation<br>StackSets](concurrency-mode.md "concurrency-mode.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | November 9, 2023  |
| Detailed StackSet drift information                                                           | The following APIs allow you to see which stack instances have drifted from the<br>StackSet template and which resources have drifted.<br>[ListStackInstanceResourceDrifts](../APIReference/API_ListStackInstanceResourceDrifts.md "../APIReference/API_ListStackInstanceResourceDrifts.md")<br>Returns drift information for resources in a stack instance.<br>[StackInstanceResourceDriftsSummary](../APIReference/API_StackInstanceResourceDriftsSummary.md "../APIReference/API_StackInstanceResourceDriftsSummary.md")<br>The structure containing summary information about resource drifts for<br>a stack instance.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | July 24, 2023     |
| CloudFormation StackSets APIs to control AWS Organizations trust access                       | CloudFormation StackSets provides customers with the following APIs for managing<br>AWS Organizations trust access:<br>[ActivateOrganizationsAccess](../APIReference/API_ActivateOrganizationsAccess.md "../APIReference/API_ActivateOrganizationsAccess.md")<br>Activate trusted access with AWS Organizations. With trusted access between<br>StackSets and Organizations activated, the management account has permissions to<br>create and manage StackSets for your organization.<br>[DeactivateOrganizationsAccess](../APIReference/API_DeactivateOrganizationsAccess.md "../APIReference/API_DeactivateOrganizationsAccess.md")<br>Deactivates trusted access with AWS Organizations. If trusted access is<br>deactivated, the management account does not have permissions to create<br>and manage service-managed StackSets for your organization.<br>[DescribeOrganizationsAccess](../APIReference/API_DescribeOrganizationsAccess.md "../APIReference/API_DescribeOrganizationsAccess.md")<br>Retrieves information about the account's<br>`OrganizationAccess` status. This API can be called either<br>by the management account or the delegated administrator by using the<br>`CallAs` parameter. This API can also be called without the<br>`CallAs` parameter by the management account.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | June 5, 2023      |
| DescribeStackSet API                                                                          | The `DescribeStackSet` API has a new parameter to the list of<br>Regions where a given stack set is deployed. For more information,<br>see [DescribeStackSet](../APIReference/API_DescribeStackSet.md "../APIReference/API_DescribeStackSet.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | February 1, 2023  |
| Managing StackSets events with CloudFormation and Amazon EventBridge                          | CloudFormation StackSets launch event notifications via Amazon EventBridge. You can trigger<br>event-driven actions after creating, updating, or deleting your CloudFormation stack<br>sets. For more information, see [Monitoring CloudFormation and Git<br>sync events with EventBridge](eventbridge-integration.md "eventbridge-integration.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | November 16, 2022 |
| Improved insights on stack instances for stack set operations                                 | CloudFormation StackSets provides more detailed information on stack instances for<br>stack set operations:<br>[DescribeStackSetOperation](../APIReference/API_DescribeStackSetOperation.md "../APIReference/API_DescribeStackSetOperation.md")<br>You can now use `DescribeStackSetOperation` to provide the<br>count of failed stack instances for stack set operations during<br>deployment.<br>[ListStackInstances](../APIReference/API_ListStackInstances.md "../APIReference/API_ListStackInstances.md")<br>You can now use the filtering option `LastOperationID` to<br>list stack instances for stack set operations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | November 4, 2022  |
| Managing events with CloudFormation and Amazon EventBridge                                    | Receive notifications when specific CloudFormation events occur. For more information,<br>see [Monitoring CloudFormation and Git sync events with EventBridge](eventbridge-integration.md "eventbridge-integration.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | July 20, 2022     |
| Account level                                                                                 | CloudFormation announces the general availability of _account filter<br>type_, a feature that allows customers to limit deployment targets to<br>individual accounts or include additional accounts with provided OUs. For more<br>information, see [Account level targets for<br>service-managed StackSets](account-level-targets.md "account-level-targets.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | July 7, 2022      |
| CloudFormation registry                                                                       | CloudFormation announces the general availability of _Hooks_, a<br>feature that allows customers to invoke custom logic to automate actions or inspect<br>resource configurations prior to a create, update or delete stack operation. For more<br>information, see the [CloudFormation Hooks User Guide](../../../cloudformation-cli/latest/hooks-userguide/what-is-cloudformation-hooks.md "../../../cloudformation-cli/latest/hooks-userguide/what-is-cloudformation-hooks.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | February 10, 2022 |
| Stack failure options                                                                         | You can iteratively develop your applications when provisioning failures are<br>encountered by starting from the point of failure without rolling back successfully<br>provisioned resources. By specifying stack failure options, you can troubleshoot<br>resources in a `CREATE_FAILED` or `UPDATE_FAILED` status. You<br>can provision failure options for all stack deployments and change set operations.<br>For more information, see [Choose how to handle failures when<br>provisioning resources](stack-failure-options.md "stack-failure-options.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | August 30, 2021   |
| Import stacks to stack set                                                                    | You can now import existing stacks into new or existing stack sets. For more<br>information, see [Importing stacks into CloudFormation StackSets](stacksets-import.md "stacksets-import.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | July 28, 2021     |
| Increased quota                                                                               | You can now declare a defaulted maximum of `2000` stacks in your<br>AWS account. For more information, see [Understand CloudFormation<br>quotas](cloudformation-limits.md "cloudformation-limits.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | July 15, 2021     |
| Publish public third-party extensions                                                         | You can now use public extensions provided by third-party publishers, just as you<br>would extensions from AWS. For more information, see [Use third-party public extensions from the<br>CloudFormation registry](registry-public.md "registry-public.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | June 21, 2021     |
| Reference macros in stack set templates                                                       | StackSets now supports creating or updating stack sets with self-managed<br>permissions from templates that reference macros. For more information about macros,<br>see [Perform custom<br>processing on CloudFormation templates with template macros](template-macros.md "template-macros.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | April 14, 2021    |
| Use the latest value of a Systems Manager parameter in a dynamic reference                    | You can now have CloudFormation use the latest version of an Systems Manager parameter whenever<br>you create or update a stack. You are no longer required to specify a specific<br>version. For more details, see [Get a plaintext value from Systems Manager<br>Parameter Store](dynamic-references-ssm.md "dynamic-references-ssm.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | April 13, 2021    |
| Modules support using period delimiters in resource names                                     | You can now use a period as a delimiter in specifying the fully-qualified logical<br>name for a resource contained in a module. For more information, see [Reference module<br>resources in CloudFormation templates](module-ref-resources.md "module-ref-resources.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | April 8, 2021     |
| CloudFormation StackSets now supports parallel region deployment                              | You can now choose to deploy StackSets into Regions sequentially or in parallel.<br>For more information, see [Stack set operation<br>options](what-is-cfnstacksets.md#stackset-ops-options "what-is-cfnstacksets.md#stackset-ops-options").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | April 6, 2021     |
| CloudFormation StackSets now supports delegated administrator with AWS Organizations          | In addition to the organization's management account, delegated administrator<br>accounts can create and manage stack sets with service-managed permissions for their<br>organization. For more information, see [Register a delegated<br>administrator member account](stacksets-orgs-delegated-admin.md "stacksets-orgs-delegated-admin.md") and [Create CloudFormation<br>StackSets with service-managed permissions](stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.md "stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | February 18, 2021 |
| CloudFormation StackSets Region availability                                                  | CloudFormation StackSets is now available in the Asia Pacific (Osaka) Region. For<br>more information, see [Managing stacks across accounts and<br>Regions with StackSets](what-is-cfnstacksets.md "what-is-cfnstacksets.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | February 10, 2021 |
| Modules                                                                                       | Modules are a way for you to package resource configurations for inclusion across<br>stack templates, in a transparent, manageable, and repeatable way. Modules can<br>encapsulate common service configurations and best practices as modular, customizable<br>building blocks for you to include in your stack templates. For more information, see<br>[Create reusable resource<br>configurations that can be included across templates with CloudFormation<br>modules](modules.md "modules.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | November 24, 2020 |
| Change sets for nested stacks                                                                 | With change sets for nested stacks you can preview the changes to your application<br>and infrastructure resources across the entire nested stack hierarchy and proceed<br>with updates when you've confirmed that all the changes are as intended. For more<br>information, see [Change sets for nested<br>stacks](change-sets-for-nested-stacks.md "change-sets-for-nested-stacks.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | November 18, 2020 |
| Increased quotas                                                                              | The following AWS CloudFormation quotas have been updated.<br>• You can now declare a maximum of `200` mappings in your<br>AWS CloudFormation template.<br>• You can now declare a maximum of `200` mapping attributes for<br>each mapping in your AWS CloudFormation template.<br>• You can now declare a maximum of `200` outputs in your<br>AWS CloudFormation template.<br>• You can now declare a maximum of `200` parameters in your<br>AWS CloudFormation template.<br>• You can now declare a maximum of `500` resources in your<br>AWS CloudFormation template.<br>• You can now pass a template body with a maximum size of `1 MB`<br>in an Amazon S3 object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | October 22, 2020  |
| Drift detection for private resources                                                         | CloudFormation now supports drift detection operations on an expanded list of AWS<br>resources, as well as private resources that are defined as provisonable in the<br>CloudFormation registry. For more information, see [Resource type<br>support](resource-import-supported-resources.md "resource-import-supported-resources.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | October 1, 2020   |
| Updated permissions required for registering resource providers                               | Registering a resource provider in your account now requires you have permission<br>to access the schema handler package uploaded to an S3 bucket for that resource<br>provider. For more information, see [IAM<br>permissions for registering a third-party private extension](registry-private.md#registry-register-permissions "registry-private.md#registry-register-permissions").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | August 7, 2020    |
| Resource import supports provisionable private resource types                                 | Import operations now support private resource types that are<br>_provisionable_; that is, whose provisioning type is either<br>`FULLY_MUTABLE` or `IMMUTABLE`. For more information, see<br>[Resources that support<br>import operations](resource-import-supported-resources.md "resource-import-supported-resources.md").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | June 3, 2020      |
